title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix
selection_reason: Production paged-serving KV layer using asymmetric paging for shared prefixes versus request suffixes plus regime-aware backend dispatch; reports up to 2.16x output-token throughput.
